text:
mira: quick flag — I ran a smoke test on the streaming convo API and noticed inconsistent 'tool_call' deltas when the tool has optional params. seems like older SDKs choke if the first delta only contains a partial name without params. example below — is this intended behavior?

jonathan: hmm, can you paste the exact stream frames you saw?

mira: yep. observed frames (newline-delimited):
```
{"type":"delta", "role":"assistant", "delta": {"content": "Invoking lookup..."}}
{"type":"delta", "delta": {"tool_call": {"name": "geo_lookup"}}}
{"type":"delta", "delta": {"tool_call": {"params": {"city": "Seattle"}}}}
{"type":"done", "final_response": { ... }}
```
This means the initial tool_call frame has name only, later frame supplies params. old parsers expect tool_call to be atomic.

casey: thanks — that matches a change we landed in runtime last week to reduce token duplication for very large tool params. intent was to stream the name first then params incrementally. didn't consider older SDK parsing.

sam: we need to decide: 1) roll back to atomic tool_call frames, 2) document the incremental tool_call streaming and bump the streaming schema version, or 3) emit an explicit marker so parsers know more deltas are coming (e.g., \"tool_call_partial\").

mira: leaning toward option 3 as the least-breaking. if we add a small boolean like \"more_to_come\" in the first tool_call delta that signals partial, SDKs can treat it as a multipart field. e.g.:
```
{"type":"delta", "delta": {"tool_call": {"name":"geo_lookup", "more_to_come": true}}}
```

jonathan: that seems reasonable. runtime change should be tiny. SDKs can fallback: if they see tool_call with name and no params and no more_to_come then treat as final; if more_to_come==true then buffer until params arrive.

casey: agree. i'll draft a tiny runtime patch to add \"more_to_come\" for incremental emits. also will add a short note in the streaming fields section of our API docs and a migration note for SDKs.

sam: please include a compatibility test in eng-platform CI that runs the older python sdk parser against the incremental case. we should fail CI if it regresses.

mira: filed a quick PR skeleton: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/infra/pull/4876 — contains runtime toggle + example fixtures.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging on \`infra/streaming-toolcall-partial\` (build #3245).

jonathan: thanks — two followups: (a) can we also ensure the streaming schema docs include a compact example for clients showing how to reassemble multipart tool_call (one-liner python pseudo code)? (b) add a note about latency implications (buffering until first params chunk).

casey: will do both. adding to my todo and the PR description.

mira: awesome. can someone from SDK team (sam?) add a tiny parser change to tolerate multipart streams? just a couple lines: buffer until final tool_call or more_to_come==false.

sam: yes, will add a compatibility shim to python/js sdks today and tag for release.

mira: perfect. marking as resolved for now. :thumbsup:

casey: leaving a small follow-up task to monitor any post-staging errors — I'll open an incident stub if we see parsing exceptions.

sam: noted. ping me in thread if staging logs show \"KeyError: params\".

mira: thanks everyone — will update the PR with docs + test link later today.
